declarations.name: nymanBeurlingHardyKernel
declarations.doc: The diagonal reproducing kernel of `H²` of a half-plane in the Plancherel normalization `‖F‖² = (1/2π)∫|F|²`.

declarations.name: BDCarrier
declarations.doc: The Nyman--Beurling carrier: `L²` of the tail ray.

declarations.name: bdTargetFun
declarations.doc: The Nyman--Beurling target `1_{(0,1]}`, in the tail coordinate.

declarations.name: norm_bdTarget
declarations.doc: The Nyman--Beurling target is a unit vector**, so every Báez-Duarte distance lies in `[0,1]`.

declarations.name: riemannHypothesis_of_bdTarget_mem_closedSpan
declarations.doc: The Nyman--Beurling criterion, sufficient direction.** If the target `1_{(0,1]}` is in the closed span of the Báez-Duarte generators, the Riemann hypothesis holds.

declarations.name: BeurlingSystem
declarations.doc: A Beurling generalized prime system: prime labels with real norms exceeding one.

declarations.name: beurlingBlock
declarations.doc: The Bernoulli-scaled Laurent block of a finite Beurling system.

declarations.name: beurlingCountermodel_zero_im_pos
declarations.doc: The off-line zero of the Beurling countermodel lies in the upper half-plane.

declarations.name: beurlingCountermodel_seam_hyperbolicPlane
declarations.doc: The Beurling countermodel's off-line zero is one hyperbolic plane of the seam carrier.**

declarations.name: not_exists_beurling_reciprocalContinuous_divisorFaithful_entireDet2
declarations.doc: Reciprocal-topology divisor firewall.** There is no Hilbert--Schmidt kernel assignment which is continuous at the rational source for reciprocal generalized-prime mass and sends every selected off-critical Beurling zero to a fixed normalized zero of its entire regularized determinant, provided the base determinant is nonzero there.

declarations.name: SatisfiesBeurlingDeny
declarations.doc: The first Beurling–Deny inequality for a real bilinear pairing of functions on the line: nonnegative vectors with disjoint supports have nonpositive cross value.

declarations.name: riemannHypothesis_of_tendsto_bdDistDiscrete
declarations.doc: `d_N → 0 ⟹ RH`.** The Nyman--Beurling/Báez-Duarte criterion in its classical form: if the distances from `1_{(0,1]}` to the spans of the first `N` functions `({u/n} − {u}/n)/u` tend to zero, the Riemann hypothesis holds.

exploration.name: infDist_pos_fractDilate
exploration.doc: The dilate family is obstructed.** The Nyman--Beurling target is at positive distance from the span of any finite family of distinct dilates `{u ↦ {θu}/u}` with `θ ∈ (0,1)` — unconditionally.

exploration.name: riemannHypothesis_of_constStep_mem_closedSpan
exploration.doc: The Nyman--Beurling criterion in the discrete carrier.** If the constant sequence `1` lies in the closed span of the modular sequences `n ↦ (n mod m)/m` inside `ℓ²(ℕ≥1, 1/(n(n+1)))` — transported here as step vectors — then the Riemann hypothesis holds. No integral and no zeta function occurs in the hypothesis.

exploration.name: System
exploration.doc: A Beurling system: generalized prime powers of magnitude at least one, carrying nonnegative weights, with finitely many atoms below every threshold.
